target_customer: German building services and craftsman businesses (SHK, electrical trades)
problem: Craft businesses miss calls and lose time to admin; Hey Telo answers calls, books appointments and writes into trade software.
product_category: Voice AI phone assistant for trades

founders.name: Christopher Grittner
education: TUM, BS Computer Science and Business

founders.name: Daniel Grittner
education: Left TUM MS to start company

technical_complexity.rationale: German voice agent with calendar and trade software integrations (pds, KWP, mfr).

defensibility.rationale: Integrations with trade software help; several German AI phone assistants for trades exist.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitors offer trade phone assistants; pds integrated Hey Telo per Handwerksblatt.

market_need_then: Handwerk businesses miss calls while on jobs; founders cite 1 million German craftsman businesses (YC launch post). Site claims 300+ customers, unverified.

branding.community_and_virality: Listed at SHK trade fair exhibitor list

brand_strength.rationale: Friendly voice-assistant style name; the word Telo is confusable with unrelated Telo companies in funding searches. No deeper brand coverage.

outcome_analysis: Hey Telo is a two person brother led company in the Winter 2025 batch selling German language voice AI to trades, and its site claims over 300 businesses. A software vendor integration is a distribution plus. No funding amount, exit or failure was found. Local competitors target the same niche, so execution on integrations decides the outcome.
notes: No dated German competitor sources near the batch were found, so the competitor list is empty as of founding. Funding: a directory lists Y Combinator Rebel Fund as investor with no amount; not recorded as a round. Location conflicts (Munich vs Berlin). Outcome search returned nothing relevant.
